invitation.body: {space} is a shared space to record expenses, split them and see who owes whom.
invitation.signIn: I have an account: sign in
invitation.note: After creating the account you come back here to accept.
invitation.signedInBody: You are signed in as {email}. Once you accept, {space} shows in your space switcher.
invitation.otherAccount: This invitation is for another account and you are signed in as {email}.
invitation.otherAccountBody: Sign in with the account the invitation was sent to.
invitation.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask {name} for a new link.
invitation.revoked: This invitation is no longer valid: it was revoked.
invitation.revokedBody: If you still want to join, ask {name} for a new invitation.

claim.kickerAnonymous: You were sent your place in
claim.title: {space}, as {guest}
claim.body: In {space} you already appear as {guest} (guest). Claiming the place moves what you paid, your shares and the payments you received to your account, unchanged.
claim.bodyNoGuest: In {space} you already have a guest place. Claiming it moves what you paid, your shares and the payments you received to your account, unchanged.
claim.signedInBody: Claiming moves your guest place in {space}, with all its history, to this account.
claim.note: Single use. After creating the account you come back here.

verify.verifiedBody: You can now accept the invitations sent to this email. Open the invitation again to join.
